hero.menu: Easy does it! Just give me a hand.

wardrobe.info: Rare items take 3 ad views each
wardrobe.forSection: This item is a reward for finishing a section

m1.question: Wake Valera up
m1.hint: What in the house was made specially for waking people?
m1.wrong: Zzz… Leave me be, I'm asleep.
m1.win: Huh? What? Okay, okay, I'm up! Oh, for crying out loud…

m2.question: Valera can't open his eyes
m2.start: My eyes won't open. It's dark!
m2.hint: Something shines through the window in the morning. But something is in its way.
m2.win: Whoa, the sun! Right in my eye! Okay, I'm awake.

m3.question: Find the second slipper
m3.start: I've got one slipper. Where's the other?
m3.hint: The cat looks a bit too comfortable. You can move him.
m3.wrong: That's not a slipper. I know my slippers!
m3.win: There it is! Whiskers, that's not a pillow.

m4.question: How many socks does Valera have?
m4.start: Count carefully. I lost track myself.
m4.hint: Socks are not only on the floor. Take a look at Valera himself.
m4.wrong: That doesn't add up. Did you count the ones on me?
m4.win: Five! Three on the floor and two on me. Still no matching pair.

m5.question: Make Valera some coffee
m5.early: An empty mug! I don't drink air.
m5.poured: Oh, that smell! Hand it over.
m5.hint: First the coffee goes into the mug. Then the mug goes to Valera.
m5.wrong: Oh, come on, not like that!

m6.question: Brush Valera's teeth
m6.early: A brush with no toothpaste? Not fair.
m6.paste: There it goes. Now give me the brush.
m6.hint: Toothpaste gets squeezed: press the tube and hold. Then the brush goes to his mouth.
m6.wrong: Nope. I'm brushing teeth, not that.

m7.question: Valera is running late. Help him
m7.hint: If there's not enough time, you can… wind it back. Turn the clock hand.
m7.wrong: Wrong way! Now I'm even later!
m7.win: Easy does it! Plenty of time now.

m8.question: Help find the keys
m8.start: Where are my keys? They were right here!
m8.hint: The keys are right in front of you. Read the task again, one word at a time.
m8.wrong: Not there. I already looked. Twice.
m8.win: There they are! In plain sight the whole time.

m9.question: The shirt is wrinkled
m9.start: I can't go out looking like this.
m9.hint: Wrinkles hate an iron. Rub it over the shirt.

m10.question: Valera lost his glasses
m10.start: I can't see a thing! Where are my glasses?
m10.hint: Glasses usually are where you pushed them yourself. Look at Valera more closely.
m10.wrong: Not there. Though without glasses I can't see what's there.
m10.win: On my forehead?! Oh, come on. Tell no one.

m11.question: The fridge is empty. Feed Valera
m11.start: I'm starving. And the fridge is a desert.
m11.hint: A fridge has more than one door. Look where it's colder.

m12.question: Cook the dumplings
m12.start: Dumplings don't cook themselves. I checked.
m12.potOn: Pot is in place. What's next?
m12.earlyKnob: The stove is heating nothing! Pot first.
m12.earlyPelmeni: Into cold water? That's not how we do it.
m12.hint: Just like at home: pot on the stove, then the heat, then the dumplings.
m12.wrong: That's not how you cook, come on!

m13.question: The cat won't let Valera out
m13.start: Whiskers, move. I have to go to work!
m13.found: Oh, sausage. I'd eat it myself…
m13.hint: The cat will leave the door if you offer something more interesting than a door. Check the fridge.
m13.win: Deal. Sausage is the entry fee.

m14.question: The lift is broken. How many floors will Valera walk down from the 9th to the 1st?
m14.start: On foot. From the ninth. Oh, come on.
m14.hint: From the ninth to the eighth is one floor. Count the trips, not the floors.
m14.wrong: I counted with my legs, and it doesn't add up.
m14.win: Eight! My legs ache, but it's exercise.

m15.question: It's raining and there is no umbrella
m15.hint: You don't need an umbrella if there is no cloud. The screen isn't that big.
m15.win: Beautiful! No cloud, no umbrella needed.

m16.question: Catch the bus
m16.hint: Only Valera can run here. Hurry him along: fast, and many times.
m16.wrong: Not that! The bus is leaving!
m16.win: Made it! Phew… The early bird… I forget the rest.

m17.question: Pay the fare
m17.start: My wallet has zero. Absolutely zero.
m17.hint: Valera has no money. Do you? Look at what's on the screen besides the bus.
m17.win: Thanks, you saved me! I'll pay you back on payday.

m18.question: Don't sleep through the stop
m18.start: Zzz… wake me at the factory…
m18.hint: Don't press Stop right away. Press it when the place Valera is going to shows up in the window.
m18.win: The factory! We're here. Easy does it.

m19.question: The guard won't let Valera in without a pass
m19.start: My pass… I had a pass somewhere…
m19.hint: Valera has the pass on him. It's just hanging the wrong way round.
m19.wrong: No pass, no entry. I know!
m19.win: There it is! Around my neck the whole time.

m20.question: The boss is coming! Make it look like Valera has been working for hours
m20.start: Zzz… I'm not sleeping, I'm thinking…
m20.pillowOff: What pillow? There was no pillow.
m20.hint: A working man wears a hard hat and holds a tool. And there should be nothing soft nearby.
m20.wrong: No time for tea! The boss is coming!

s1.question: Who is the main character here?
s1.hint: The main character stands off to the side, modestly quiet.
s1.win: Me! Of course it's me! Thanks for noticing.

s2.question: Who is rustling in the bushes?
s2.start: Someone is there. I'm not scared. Almost.
s2.hint: One bush is moving. You can rub a bush away with your finger.
s2.win: Whiskers! How did you get here?

s3.question: Valera is having a nightmare. Rub it out
s3.hint: What does Valera hate every single morning? Rub it with your finger.
s3.wrong: No, no, that's the nice part! Bring it back!
s3.win: The alarm clock is gone! Back to sleep. Beautiful.

s4.question: Scratch off the grey layer
s4.start: A lottery! I'm about to be rich.
s4.hint: The grey layer rubs off like a scratch card. Rub it with your finger.
s4.win: A sock?! Well, now I have six.
